findings.description: Product prices on the product list change on every page load (e.g. Backpack showed $61.29, then $80.13 on reload), so the list shows different prices for the same products each time it is opened.
repro: Compare the prices: they differ for every product

findings.description: The price shown for a product on the product list does not match its detail page or the cart. For example, Sauce Labs Onesie is $98.54 on the list but $7.99 on its detail page and in the cart; Sauce Labs Backpack is $29.99 on its detail page but a different value on the list.
repro: Note the Sauce Labs Onesie price on /inventory.html
Open the Onesie detail page and note its price
Add the Onesie to the cart and open /cart.html

findings.description: On the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card, the Add to cart button overflows the right edge of its card and sits outside the card border, unlike the other cards.
repro: Look at the Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) card in the bottom-right of the product grid

findings.description: Product names on the Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt and Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket cards are indented to the right, while the other cards' names are left-aligned with the description, so the card layout is inconsistent.
repro: Compare the name position on the Bolt T-Shirt and Fleece Jacket cards with the Backpack card

notes: Tested the login, browse, detail, add/remove (list and detail), sort, cart, checkout (totals: tax 8% correct on the one-item checkout), confirmation, and logout journeys with Playwright. Sort orders were correct. No console errors or HTTP errors were seen. The checkout totals were checked on a single item only. The brief's out path (/bench/out) was not used because the prompt specified the workspace path.
